messages:
emma: Quick heads-up — planning a schema change tonight in the 00:30-01:30 UTC window. Adds `user.first_seen_ts` (nullable) + backfill job. Will pin API v2.3 for reads during rollout to avoid client mismatch.
raj: ack. which shards/tenants are in scope?
olga: light subset of tenants (10%) for canary. backfill is chunked, target 50k rows/minute.
emma: canary set = tenant ids 1000-1999. deploybot: scheduled migration job 3851234567 queued for 2026-03-25T00:30:00Z.
kevin: rollout plan reminder — canary for 30m, monitor 5xx, latency, and replica lag. if lag > 30s or 5xx spike > 0.5% for 5m, abort.
raj: add one more check: QPS drop >20% for core read paths -> rollback.
emma: noted. rollback criteria summarized: 1) replica lag >30s 2) 5xx spike >0.5% sustained 5m 3) QPS drop >20% 4) unexpected migration locks > 5s on shards.
olga: backfill snippet for ops team:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN first_seen_ts timestamptz;
-- backfill in small batches
COMMIT;
```
emma: we'll run a dry-run apply on canary cluster at 00:00 UTC. post-dry-run: smoke test w/ sample queries + ingest.
kevin: who's on pager? @oncall-sdb tonight is me. I'll be watching latency + replication. raj can help with rollback if we need to pin older schema.
deploybot: NOTE: pinned version request created: api_v2.3 -> pinned on read route for production during window. ID: pin-385123.
raj: if we need to rollback, what's the chosen escape hatch? full rollback of schema vs feature flag toggle?
emma: plan A = pause backfill + unpin v2.3 -> clients read older view (no new column usage). Plan B (if DDL must be reverted) = deploy backward-compatible swap using short-lived shadow column and migrate back; that's disruptive so avoid unless absolutely needed.
olga: during canary we'll also run `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE first_seen_ts IS NULL` every 10m to validate progress.
kevin: I'll place a manual holdpoint at 00:45 (canary end) — if all green we proceed to ramp to 50% then 100% over next 90m.
emma: release notes (short): "Add nullable users.first_seen_ts. Backfill started in chunks; API reads pinned to v2.3 during rollout. Watch replication and 5xxs; rollback criteria documented in thread."
raj: copying runbook snippets into runbook doc now. ping me on this thread if we see any lock storms. :loud_sound:
kevin: thumbs up. I'll post a final preflight at 00:20 UTC.
emma: thanks — see you in the channel during the window.
